unit_name: Tax returns prepared worldwide (assisted + DIY; U.S., Canada, Australia, other)
how_this_file_was_made: Each figure was read from the 10-K text by Claude Code (an LLM agent) during the build session and is re-checked by the notebook: the quote must appear verbatim in the cached filing text, the number must sit in the stated column, and the printed page is computed from the filing's page footers. Accession numbers and URLs are looked up in code from EDGAR submissions, not typed here.
selection_rule: For each fiscal year, use the most recent 10-K that reports a figure for the SAME period (latest restated). FY2013-FY2022 come from the 'Tax returns prepared worldwide' row of the Operating Statistics table in MD&A. HRB stopped publishing that table after FY2022, so FY2023-FY2026 come from the one sentence every 10-K still carries in Item 1 (Competitive Conditions): 'X million returns filed by or through H&R Block in fiscal year YYYY'. For FY2021 and FY2022 that sentence matches the table exactly (25.2 vs 25,178; 23.6 vs 23,600), which is the evidence that it is the same measure.

transition_period.note: HRB moved its fiscal year end from April 30 to June 30 in 2021. May 1-June 30, 2021 is a two-month transition period with no annual 10-K cost figure, so it is not a data point. Returns filed in it are missing from the cumulative count; the FY2021 10-K gives a partial figure, used only in a sensitivity check.
transition_period.quote: We prepared 2.9 million U.S. assisted and DIY returns from May 1, 2021 to May 18, 2021 due to the extension of the current tax season.

free_file.note: Through FY2019 the worldwide total includes IRS Free File returns (shown on their own line); the FY2021 10-K restated FY2020 without that line. Used only in a sensitivity check that subtracts them from FY2013-FY2019 (approximate: the FY2020 restatement also moved 285K returns into DIY).

mix_check.note: U.S. assisted returns at the two ends of the window, to show the direction of mix shift. Definitions differ slightly (FY2026 counts virtual returns as assisted), so only the direction is used.
